node.title: THE RESIDUE: certify min ternary distance > 2l' for the explicit k x N' system
node.statement: For every row assigned to this lattice route, pin the prime field, quotient order and root, exact class cell and cardinality, support bound 2l', integer kernel matrix, and allowed cyclotomic-relation basis. Prove by a machine-checkable certificate that no non-cyclotomic ternary kernel vector within the support bound remains and that the cell cardinality exceeds B*. There is no hidden finite official-prime registry: closure must be family-uniform, or explicitly exhibit-scoped with every consumer narrowed to the same field. The complete order-128 branch with p>253^32 is proved analytically by integer_code_distance_high_field_folded_box_exclusion; lower fields, other orders, the universal row assignment, and the row value-set budget remain open.
node.attack_surface: Before computation, bind the literal row payload and prove its exact class count exceeds B*. Apply integer_code_distance_high_field_folded_box_exclusion first on order-128 prime-field rows. On a residual pinned row use proof-logged pseudo-Boolean/SAT, MITM, or LP/Delsarte. A collision verdict is a valid route outcome but does not prove this no-vector target. E24's BKZ hunt is search evidence only.
node.falsifier: a non-cyclotomic ternary kernel vector inside the declared support bound, or a declared cell whose exact cardinality is at most B*
